scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded king in an ivory robe, russet mantle, and gold circlet raises one hand toward a thick dark cloud filling a temple entrance. Warm stone steps, tall wooden columns with gold details, a bronze basin, olive branches, and distant hills surround the sunlit courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative First Temple scene pairs Solomon's declaration with an opaque cloud hiding the sanctuary, reflecting the verse's thick darkness. His appearance, gesture, clothing, architecture, and courtyard details are illustrative choices rather than details supplied by this verse or a historical reconstruction. God is not represented as a human figure.
